# Route access pin: routes added only when DEV_MODE=true.
# Same identities and format as route_access.txt.

== /debug/pprof/ (probe /debug/pprof/nas01)
GET    anonymous       401 "unauthorized"
GET    viewer          403 "forbidden"
GET    operator        403 "forbidden"
GET    admin           404 text "Unknown profile"
GET    key-no-scope    404 text "Unknown profile"
GET    key-other-asset 403 asset-denied
POST   anonymous       401 "unauthorized"
POST   viewer          403 "forbidden"
POST   operator        403 "forbidden"
POST   admin           404 text "Unknown profile"
POST   key-no-scope    404 text "Unknown profile"
POST   key-other-asset 403 asset-denied
